policy: All datasets in the mobile offline manifest require attribution. Any dataset where redistribution rights are unclear receives mobile_packaging_class = NOT_ELIGIBLE.

attributions.attribution_text: Bus stop location data: BhubaneswarOne / CRUT — Government of Odisha. Data accuracy subject to official CRUT source.
attributions.notes: Government open service data. No formal Creative Commons license identified. Attribution required; do not imply official endorsement.

attributions.attribution_text: Mo Bus route corridors: CRUT — Capital Region Urban Transport, Government of Odisha.
attributions.notes: Approximate corridor geometries derived from official CRUT Mo Bus route descriptions.

attributions.attribution_text: District boundary data: Runfola, D. et al. (2020). geoBoundaries: A global database of political administrative boundaries. PLOS ONE 15(4). CC BY 4.0. https://www.geoboundaries.org
attributions.notes: CC BY 4.0 explicitly permits redistribution with attribution. Attribution must appear in-app for any screen displaying district map layers.

attributions.attribution_text: District hospital and civic services data: Health & Family Welfare Department, Government of Odisha; Odisha Tourism Police.
attributions.notes: Government directory data. No formal open data license identified. Contact information is subject to change; stale label required after 90 days.

attributions.attribution_text: Geographical Indication registrations: Geographical Indications Registry — CGPDTM, Government of India.
attributions.notes: Statutory public records. GI registrations are public legal notices. Attribution mandatory.

attributions.attribution_text: Artisan craft cluster data: DC Handicrafts / DC Handlooms — Ministry of Textiles, Government of India.
attributions.notes: Government directory data. artisan_count field excluded from bundling due to mutation rate.

attributions.attribution_text: GI-registered food references: Geographical Indications Registry — CGPDTM; FSSAI — Food Safety and Standards Authority of India.
Railway station data: National Train Enquiry System (NTES) — Indian Railways, Government of India.
attributions.notes: Official station codes and names are public information. No live schedule data bundled.

attributions.attribution_text: Airport data: Airports Authority of India (AAI), Government of India.
attributions.notes: IATA/ICAO codes are international standards. AAI airport master data is public. Attribution mandatory.

hard_invariants: No dataset with redistribution_confidence = LOW is included in the bundle manifest.
All CC BY 4.0 attributions must appear in in-app legal/attribution screens.
Government disclaimer attributions must appear in data source disclosure.
No fabricated licensing assertions. If rights are unclear, mobile_packaging_class = NOT_ELIGIBLE.
